entries.description: End of a listing from the previous page: a homestead held by two lesbians on 22 acres, earning farm income from bees, honey and rare poultry breeds, with off-farm income from graphic design, photography and agricultural writing. They make lesbian/feminist t-shirts and rubber stamps (Armadillo Mountain), offer apprenticeships and work exchanges in beekeeping and permaculture, and seek carpentry and stone masonry skills.
entries.raw_text: oriented homestead whose main farm income is from sales of bees and honey and from hatching rare breeds of poultry. Off-farm income is derived from graphic design, photography and writing for the organic agriculture journals. We also produce and sell lesbian/feminist t-shirts and rubber stamps under the name of Armadillo Mountain. Would welcome correspondence with other lesbians on the land. Longer-term apprenticeships/work exchanges are a possibility. Would also trade apprenticeships in beekeeping and Permaculture (particularly dryland and forage systems) for some good, solid vocational skills, especially carpentry and stone masonry. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 22 acres, good tools and equipment, dogs, cats, chickens, ducks, guineas, peabirds and 60 zillion bees.
entries.notes: Continuation of a listing begun on the previous page; name and address not on this page. Type: two-woman rule, 'We have/are: 2 lesbians'; apprenticeships/work exchanges do not change it, so Private/Individual Land. num_residents 2: 'Would welcome correspondence with other lesbians on the land' implies they live on the land as a homestead. Lesbian women: describes lesbians living there. Farming: 'homestead whose main farm income is from sales of bees and honey and from hatching rare breeds of poultry'. Workshops/education: 'apprenticeships in beekeeping and Permaculture'. Archives/cultural work: 'produce and sell lesbian/feminist t-shirts and rubber stamps under the name of Armadillo Mountain' (crafts production; judgment call). Environmentalism: Permaculture practice ('dryland and forage systems') taught on the land; judgment call.

entries.description: A 147-acre women's farm cared for by two lesbian caretakers since August 1982, needing energy and money from women to stay open for women and children. Welcomes new members/caretakers, girl children, boy children under 10, non-lesbian women, restrained dogs, and donations; especially encourages women of color. Has housing, camping space, woods and farm land. Described as an inactive group hoping to revive.
entries.raw_text: OWL FARM POB 133, Days Creek, OR 97429. We are two wimmin caretaking OWL since Aug 82. OWL is needing energy and money support from wimmin to stay open for wimmin & children. No abuse of alcohol, drugs, or violence. I encourage wimmin of color to come and be here. We welcome: new members/caretakers, girl children, boy children (under 10 years), nonlesbian women, dogs only if restrained, donations. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 147 acres, housing/permanent structures, camping space, woods, farm land, wimmin living and working the land. Inactive group with hopes to revive.
entries.notes: Type: judgment call. The two women are caretakers, not owners; the next listing states Oregon Women's Land Trust 'is in the process of buying OWL FARM', and the farm 'stay[s] open for wimmin & children', so coded Land Trust rather than Private/Individual Land. PO box, so no land street/zip; listing does not name the land town. num_residents 2: '2 lesbians' with 'wimmin living and working the land'. Non-lesbian women: named ('nonlesbian women') and 'wimmin & children' before 1986. Children: 'girl children, boy children (under 10 years)'; boy children condition under 10. Recovery: 'No abuse of alcohol, drugs, or violence'. Women of color: 'I encourage wimmin of color to come and be here'. 'Inactive group with hopes to revive.'

entries.description: A women's land trust in the process of buying OWL Farm, supported by donations; publishes a quarterly newsletter ($5/year) and holds trust meetings about every three months at the farm, which a fluctuating collective of women caretakes. Welcomes new members, girl and boy children, and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: OREGON WOMEN'S LAND TRUST PO Box 1692, Roseburg, OR 97470. OWLT is in the process of buying OWL FARM (see above). Support for the farm and trust comes from donations from those women who believe in land for women. A quarterly newsletter is printed, $5/year. Land trust meetings are held about every three months at the farm. A collective of women (the number fluctuates) caretakes the farm. We welcome: new members, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women.
entries.notes: Type: a land trust by name and purpose, buying OWL FARM. Acreage left blank: no figure given here (OWL FARM listing gives 147 acres, still being bought). num_residents blank: 'A collective of women (the number fluctuates) caretakes the farm'. PO box, so no land address. Lesbian women: questionnaire directory listing welcoming people. Non-lesbian women: 'nonlesbian women'. Children: 'girl and boy children'. Quarterly newsletter not coded as cultural work (organizational newsletter).

entries.description: A family of four lesbians living on 40 acres on a secluded forest hilltop, growing food, tending emotional and spiritual depths, and making art and song celebrating women. They invite women to theatre and Tai Chi workshops several times a year but cannot host visitors otherwise. Has housing, woods and farm land.
entries.raw_text: FLY AWAY HOME POB 593, Myrtle Creek, OR 97457. We are a family of 4 lesbians living on a secluded forest hilltop. We grow food and tender our emotional and spiritual depths. And we make art and song that celebrate woman. We invite women to our workshops in Theatre and in Tai Chi several times a year. We are unable to welcome visitors at other times. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 40 acres, housing/permanent structures, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type: 'a family of 4 lesbians living' on the land, so Intentional Community/Cooperative. num_residents 4: '4 lesbians' and 'women living and working on the land'. PO box, so no land address; land town not named. Non-lesbian women: 'We invite women to our workshops' (pre-1986 'women' in a welcome statement). Farming: 'We grow food'. Spirituality: 'tender our emotional and spiritual depths'. Workshops: 'workshops in Theatre and in Tai Chi'. Archives/cultural work: 'we make art and song that celebrate woman'.

entries.description: Two lesbian partners owning 130 acres of forest which they manage by thinning and reforestation for selective timber harvest and firewood. Has a woman-built cabin, outbuildings, a garden, chickens and pets, electricity/privy and camping space. Not separatist; male friends visit. Welcomes girl and boy children and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: STEPPING WOODS Rt 4 Box 1058, Roseburg, OR 97470. We are a partnership of 2 lesbians owning 130 acres of forested property. We manage our woods by thinning and reforestation, where necessary, for selective timber harvest and firewood. There is one woman-built cabin, a few out buildings, a garden, chickens, and pets. We are not separatists and have male friends that come on our land. We welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 130 acres, housing/permanent structures, electricity/privy, camping space, woods, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type: two-woman rule, 'a partnership of 2 lesbians owning 130 acres'. Rural route address, so land address copied from mailing address. Acreage: '130' printed with a possible overstrike in the first instance ('1[3]0'), confirmed by '130 acres' in the list. num_residents 2: '2 lesbians' and 'women living and working on the land'. Non-lesbian women and children named. Men not coded: 'have male friends that come on our land' describes visiting friends, not a welcome to men. Rejects separatism ('We are not separatists'), not coded. Forest management ('thinning and reforestation') not coded as environmentalism; it is for timber harvest and firewood.

entries.description: A rural feminist publishing center (Womanspirit and The Blatant Image) run by two lesbians aged 57 and 60 on 6+ acres, interested in photography, summer Ovulars, ecology and alternative technology. Hosts women of all ages for short or long visits at $4/day with vegetarian meals; no men, guns, pets or drugs. Welcomes non-lesbian women and women to help on projects. Has housing, outdoor toilets, generator/battery electricity, camping space, woods and gardens.
entries.raw_text: ROOTWORKS 2000 King Mountain Trail, Sunny Valley, OR 97497. A rural feminist publishing center (Womanspirit and The Blatant Image) with strong interests in photography, (summer Ovulars), ecology and alternative technology. We are 57 & 60 years old. We enjoy the company and help of women of all ages who can adapt to our simple lifestyle for short or long visits. Rules: no men, guns, pets, drugs or dope. Smoking limited to outdoors gravel area. $4/day/woman includes vegetarian meals. We welcome: nonlesbian women, women to help on projects. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 6+ acres, housing/permanent structures, outdoor toilets, electricity with generator and batteries, camping space, woods, gardens, women living and working with the land.
entries.notes: Type: judgment call. Calls itself 'A rural feminist publishing center' and hosts paying visitors, but two-woman rule applies ('2 lesbians', 'We are 57 & 60 years old'), so Private/Individual Land. Street address with no sign they live elsewhere, so land address copied. Acreage '6+ acres' stored as 6. num_residents 2: '2 lesbians' and 'women living and working with the land'. Non-lesbian women: 'nonlesbian women' and 'women of all ages'. Men excluded: 'no men'. Archives/cultural work: publishing center for Womanspirit and The Blatant Image. Environmentalism: 'ecology and alternative technology'. Recovery: 'no ... drugs or dope'. Workshops/education: '(summer Ovulars)', which were summer workshops; judgment call. Older women not coded: ages stated but listing welcomes 'women of all ages'.

entries.land_location_as_stated: situated on a large island off the coast of Maine
entries.description: A women's rooming/guest house run by two lesbians in a large, partially restored Victorian house on an island off the coast of Maine, with one bathroom, kitchen use and a large parlour; rooms $21 including tax. Welcomes girl children and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: SEA GNOMES HOME Box 33, Stonington, ME 04681 (207)367-5376. We are a womyn's rooming/guest house situated on a large island off the coast of Maine. Rooms are $21 including tax. The house is a large Victorian, partially restored, one bathroom, kitchen use, large parlour. We welcome: girl children, nonlesbian women. We are/have: 2 lesbians, 1 dog, 1 cat, house, plumbing/electricity.
entries.notes: Printed under the EDITORS' NOTE: 'These groups don't have land, perse, but we decided to include them for your information.' Included as a row (judgment call) because it is a guest house the two lesbians live in on an island off the Maine coast, unlike Gabriel's (rooms in the center of Provincetown), which is excluded. Type: a 'womyn's rooming/guest house', defined by visitors, so Retreat/Gathering Space. Box address, so no land street/zip; land_state ME from 'off the coast of Maine'. num_residents blank: '2 lesbians' but no statement that they live on the land (count noted here). Non-lesbian women and girl children named; boy children not welcomed.

entries.description: Notice that this group's multiple-ownership land holding ended in legal dissolution; some members persevere in spirit, and a large women's community remains in the Fayetteville area where a land search may be fruitful.
entries.raw_text: OZARK WIMMIN'S LAND TRUST PO Box 718, Fayetteville, AR 72702. We have tried multiple-ownership (partnership) type of land holding. The pieces of land wound up in legal dissolution eventually. Some of us persevere in the spirit. We cannot guarantee to answer letters, but if you are prepared to spend a little time in the area, a land search may be fruitful. A large wimmin's community exists.
entries.notes: Not a listing: the land 'wound up in legal dissolution eventually', so the community has ended. No type. Printed under the EDITORS' NOTE about groups without land. No land location given beyond the mailing address.

entries.description: Letter from a community listed in the previous land directory correcting its misprinted phone number; the letter continues on the next page.
entries.raw_text: Dear Ambitious Amazons: Thanks for the Land Directory and including us, it might be a problem, however, that our phone number was misprinted. Our real phone can be rung at (617)585-8826. We tried out the
entries.notes: Not a listing: a letter from a listed community correcting its listing (phone number). The community is not named on this page; name taken from the letter's opening words. The letter continues on the next page. The preceding 'Dear LC' letter from New York, NY is not from a community and is not extracted. Gabriel's (Provincetown guest rooms with no land) is also not extracted, per codebook.
